name: Tool Boy Kelvin
source:
Your boss asked you to guide and mentor a new employee on his first few days. And so enters Kelvin, your new student.
Kelvin, fresh out of school, is still young and quite eager to learn. Will you show him the ropes?

[From the [url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/tool-boy-kelvin/]official website[/url]]
translation:
老板让你在新员工入职的头几天，负责指导和带领他。于是，你的新学徒凯尔文登场了。
刚离开学校的凯尔文还很年轻，求知欲旺盛。你愿意教他入门吗？

[摘自[url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/tool-boy-kelvin/]官方网站[/url]]
